# ARTA Referral Tally — every onward referral generated by the Mercedes ARTA cases

> **Purpose.** The Mayor's 24 July 2026 letter to DILG (and MLGOO Guerrero's 31 July close-out)
> tell a national oversight agency that five of seven ARTA complaints were "recommended for
> closure," attaching "the official recommendations for closure." That is a half-quote. In the
> same one-page dispositive blocks, ARTA **referred LGU personnel onward** to the Civil Service
> Commission, the DILG, and the Office of the Ombudsman — and the CSC then referred the **Mayor
> himself** to the Ombudsman. A referral is a transfer of forum, not an exoneration.
>
> Every quote below is from the **received instrument** in the corpus (doc id noted); provenance
> = verified. Rebuilt 2026-08-18 (supersedes the 3-referral draft of 2026-08-03).

---

## THE COUNT

- **7 onward referrals** issued across the cluster.
- **4 oversight bodies** now seized: **CSC-RO V**, **CSC-OAC-L (central)**, **DILG (national CART)**, **Office of the Ombudsman**.
- **5 named officials** carried onward — including the **Municipal Mayor** and a **sitting Councilor**.
- Generated by **3 source dockets** (the two Balane cases, 1212, and 1891) out of **9** ARTA complaints filed.

## The instruments, verbatim

### A. The two Balane cases → Civil Service Commission
- **CTN SL-2025-1008-0690 and CTN SL-2025-1104-0792** — Zschoche v. MEO-Mercedes (Engr. Erwin H.
  Balane). ARTA Resolution dated **07 April 2026** (Atty. Del Rosario / USec Abot); ARTA
  **Endorsement to CSC-RO V** dated 30 April 2026 (doc 706 endorsement; doc 719 resolution;
  transmittal doc 1708 to `ro05@csc.gov.ph`).
  > "RECOMMENDATIONS — In view of the foregoing, ARTA recommends the following: 1. **CLOSURE** …
  > there being no prima facie evidence of a violation of Section 21(a), (b), (d), and (e) of R.A.
  > No. 11032; **and** 2. **REFERRAL of this case to the CIVIL SERVICE COMMISSION – REGIONAL
  > OFFICE V for its appropriate action against ENGR. ERWIN H. BALANE … on the alleged violation
  > of Section 5(a) of R.A. No. 6713.**"
  > *(Endorsement, doc 706:)* "pursuant to Section 17(d) … we hereby ENDORSE the RESOLUTION dated
  > 7 APR 2026 docketed as CTN SL-2025-1008-0690 [and 0792] … for … 6713."
- **The two Balanes.** These are the two ARTA complaints against the same Municipal Engineer;
  both were closed-and-referred to the CSC in the same 30 April 2026 endorsement.

### B. 1212 (Sangguniang Bayan) → Office of the Ombudsman (two officials)
- **CTN SL-2026-0128-1212** — Zschoche v. VM Yapyuco, Councilors Ong & Torralba. ARTA Resolution
  **01 June 2026** (doc 1614); ARTA **Endorsement to the Office of the Ombudsman** (Hon. J.C.
  Remulla), §17(d)/(e), doc 3754.
  > "2. **REFERRAL … to the OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN … against HON. PRINCESS B. TORRALBA … for the
  > alleged violation of R.A. 6713;** and 3. **REFERRAL … to the OFFICE OF THE OMBUDSMAN … against
  > TONY TEOPE, … Assistant to the Municipal Mayor … for … Section 3(i) of R.A. No. 3019.**"
- **The referral reaches inside the Mayor's own office** — Tony Teope is "Assistant to the
  Municipal Mayor." A sitting Councilor (Torralba) is the other.

### C. 1891 (the whole CART) → CSC + DILG → Ombudsman (the Mayor)
- **CTN SL-2026-0423-1891** — a standalone procedural complaint against the **Committee on
  Anti-Red Tape (CART) of Mercedes** (the LGU's own R.A. 11032 compliance body), received by ARTA
  23 Apr 2026.
- **ARTA → CSC** (Notice of Referral, 04 May 2026, §17(d), re R.A. 6713 — docs 688/689) and
  **ARTA → DILG** national CART (Notice of Referral, 04 May 2026, §17(d) — docs 705, 701).
- **CSC → Ombudsman** — **CSC OAC-L Letter No. 270, s. 2026, dated 23 June 2026** (docs 1195,
  1196), transmitting the ARTA referral to **Ombudsman Remulla**:
  > "against the members of the Committee on Anti-Red Tape (CART) of the Municipal Government of
  > Mercedes, Camarines Norte, with **Hon. Alexander Pajarillo, in his capacity as the Municipal
  > Mayor and as the CART Chairperson**, for violation of … R.A. 6713 … the official involved is
  > an **elective official and thus within the disciplinary jurisdiction of** [the Ombudsman]."
- **This is the chain Jonathan flagged:** the entire CART → CSC and DILG → and the CSC then sent
  the **Mayor (an elective official) and the CART members** on to the Ombudsman.

## Why this matters

1. **"Recommended for closure" is a half-quote.** In 0690/0792, 1212, and the 1891→CSC→Ombudsman
   step, the *same dispositive paragraph* that says CLOSURE also says REFERRAL. Sending DILG only
   the closure half, as proof of vindication, omits a material fact — in a submission the Mayor
   signed.
2. **The referrals reach the top of the LGU.** The Mayor himself (via 1891/CSC), his own
   Assistant (Teope, via 1212), a Councilor (Torralba, via 1212), and the Municipal Engineer
   (Balane, via 0690/0792) are all now before the CSC or the Ombudsman.
3. **No res judicata on the substance.** ARTA's closures were narrow §4(f)/prima-facie threshold
   calls; ARTA itself said (21 May + 21 Jul letters) it did not adjudicate the merits and did not
   foreclose relief in "the proper forum."
